title: 第四十四章 龙圣抗天罚逆念破万古第四十三章 圣脉衍天地逆轮觅生机
lines: 天幕沉沉，灰芒覆世。
整座京城的天光被尽数遮蔽，无风无雷，无声无息，却是万古以来最恐怖的天地威压倾覆人间。
不同于厮杀打斗的血腥凛冽，这天罚是极致的冰冷、无情、绝对。
天道规则高悬万古，视众生为蝼蚁，视圣女血脉为制衡工具，从未有过半分情面。
满城百姓只觉心口莫名沉闷、天色骤暗，依旧如常生活，浑然不知虚空之上，一场针对宿命棋眼的万古天罚，已然轰然落定。
唯有摄政王府上空，劫锁纵横虚空，灰蒙蒙的天道威压层层碾压、密不透风，死死锁定院中白衣身影。
“不许碰她分毫。”
萧聿辞眸色骤然寒彻万丈，周身金色龙气冲天贯地，万千皇权符文盘旋周身，化作一层坚不可摧的至尊屏障，将沈清鸢严严实实护在身后。
人间皇权，乃是天地人道正统，是唯一可抗衡天道私刑的世俗至力。
轰隆隆——！
第一重圣女神魂噬念劫，轰然砸落！
没有惊天巨响，没有杀伐利刃。
无形无色的天道念力，裹挟着万年所有圣女的悲凉、不甘、牺牲、怨念，化作最阴毒的神魂攻击，穿透一切屏障，直刺心神！
这是天道最狠的手段。
不毁肉身，不灭灵力，只以代代圣女的宿命悲剧反噬其身，摧其心志、崩其神魂。
万年血泪、万载孤苦、无数少女年少赴死的绝望悲戚，一瞬间尽数灌入沈清鸢识海！
无数破碎残影在她脑海炸开，无数悲恸哭声萦绕神魂，压得她头颅剧痛、身形微晃。
“鸢儿！”
萧聿辞眼睁睁看着她脸色骤然苍白、唇色失尽，心头骤然一紧，气血翻涌至炸裂。
他能挡术法、挡煞气、挡万物杀伐，唯独挡不住侵入神魂的无形天念！
天道不公，莫过于此。
仗万古规则，欺一世温柔。
“稳住！有我在！”
萧聿辞单手紧紧揽住她摇摇欲坠的腰身，将她牢牢扣在怀中，滚烫掌心贴着她后心，倾尽毕生龙气源源不断渡入她体内，替她缓冲神魂剧痛。
霸道温暖的皇权灵力，如定海神针，稳住她震颤的识海。
沈清鸢靠在他怀中，强忍万千悲恸，睫毛颤抖，却不肯退缩半分。
她听见了万年初代圣女的轻叹，听见了代代圣女无声的悲鸣，听见了她们被困轮回、身不由己的无尽绝望。
她们认命，是因为无人并肩、无路可逃。
可她不认！
沈清鸢骤然抬眸，眼底柔光化利刃，周身莹白圣脉之光骤然暴涨！
“万年圣女，从非天命祭品！”
“你们的隐忍、牺牲、不甘，今日由我尽数承接，由我尽数平反！”
她不再抗拒涌入识海的怨念，反而以圆满圣脉、半圣神魂，温柔接纳、温柔安抚、温柔净化所有万年悲念。
刺骨的绝望，被她温柔消融。
固化的宿命，被她意念撼动。
沉沦万载的残魂执念，终于得以片刻安宁、得以被人理解、被人共情。
虚空缝隙深处，蛰伏观战的血色残魂骤然震颤，暴怒不止！
“废物！该死！！”
他躲在天道盲区，算计得天衣无缝。
本想借天道天罚，逼出万年圣女怨念，再暗中偷偷吸纳怨念壮大残魂，坐收渔利、借天罚养己身！
待沈清鸢神魂崩碎、无力抗天，他便可顺势接管圣女圣脉，重启完美轮回，执掌万古天道棋局！
可他万万没想到，沈清鸢竟能以圣脉净化怨念、共情万载残魂！
不仅毫发无伤，反而借万年圣女执念加持，圣力愈发醇厚、神魂愈发稳固！
偷鸡不成，反助对手变强！
“我算计天道，你偏要逆天向善！”残魂阴毒嘶吼，“那我便看你能护万古悲魂多久！”
content_en:
The sky is dark and gray.
The skylight of the entire capital city was completely blocked, there was no wind, no thunder, and there was no sound, but it was the most terrifying coercion of heaven and earth in all eternity that overturned the world.
Unlike the bloody and brutal fighting, this heavenly punishment is extremely cold, ruthless, and absolute.
The rules of heaven have been upheld for eternity. He regards all living beings as ants and the blood of the saint as a tool of checks and balances. He has never shown any mercy.
The people all over the city felt an inexplicable dullness in their hearts and the sky suddenly darkened, and they continued to live their lives as usual, unaware that in the void, an eternal punishment for the fateful chess player had been decided.
Only in the sky above the Prince Regent's Palace were tribulation locks crisscrossing the sky, and the gray pressure of heaven was crushing and airtight, tightly locking onto the figure in white in the courtyard.
"Don't touch her at all."
Xiao Yuci's eyes suddenly turned as cold as ice, and the golden dragon energy around him shot up to the sky and the earth. Thousands of imperial power runes circled around him, turning into an indestructible supreme barrier, strictly protecting Shen Qingyuan behind him.
The imperial power of the human world is the orthodoxy of heaven and earth and the only secular power that can resist the lynching of heaven.
Rumble——!
The first level of Holy Goddess Soul Devouring Tribulation crashed down!
There was no loud noise, no killing blade.
The invisible and colorless power of heaven's will, enveloping the sadness, unwillingness, sacrifice, and resentment of all the saints for thousands of years, turned into the most vicious soul attack, penetrating all barriers and piercing the heart!
This is the cruelest method of heaven.
The physical body is not destroyed, the spiritual power is not destroyed, but the tragedy of the fate of the saints from generation to generation comes back to bite her body, destroy her mind, and destroy her soul.
Thousands of years of blood and tears, tens of thousands of years of loneliness, and the despair and sorrow of countless young girls dying, all poured into Shen Qingyuan's sea of ​​consciousness in an instant!
Countless broken afterimages exploded in her mind, and countless mournful cries lingered in her soul, causing severe pain in her head and shaking body.
"Yuan'er!"
Xiao Yuci watched helplessly as her face suddenly turned pale and her lips lost all color. Her heart suddenly tightened and her energy and blood surged to the point of bursting.
He can block spells, evil spirits, and the killing blows of all things, but he can't block the invisible thoughts of heaven that invade the soul!
Nothing is more unfair than this.
Rely on the eternal rules and deceive me into being gentle.
"Hold on! I'm here!"
Xiao Yuci tightly held her shaky waist with one hand and held her tightly in his arms. His hot palm was pressed against her back, and he poured all his life's dragon energy into her body to buffer her from the severe pain in her soul.
The domineering and warm spiritual power of the imperial power was like a needle that stabilized the sea, stabilizing her trembling sea of ​​consciousness.
Shen Qingyuan leaned in his arms, holding back all kinds of grief, her eyelashes trembled, but she refused to shrink back even a little.
She heard the sighs of the saints from the first ten thousand years, the silent cries of the saints from generation to generation, and the endless despair of them being trapped in reincarnation and unable to control themselves.
They resigned to their fate because there was no one beside them and there was no way to escape.
But she doesn’t admit it!
Shen Qingyuan suddenly raised his eyes, the soft light in his eyes turned into sharp blades, and the light of the white holy veins around him suddenly surged!
"The Ten Thousand Years Saintess is never a sacrifice of destiny!"
"Your forbearance, sacrifice, and unwillingness will all be taken over by me today and vindicated by me!"
She no longer resisted the resentment pouring into the sea of consciousness. Instead, she used her perfect holy veins and semi-holy soul to gently accept, gently comfort, and gently purify all the thousands of years of sorrow.
The biting despair was melted away by her gentleness.
The solidified fate was shaken by her thoughts.
The residual obsession that had been sinking for thousands of years finally found peace for a moment, and was understood and sympathized with by others.
Deep in the gap in the void, the bloody soul that was dormant and watching the battle suddenly trembled and became furious!
"Trash! Damn it!!"
He hides in the blind spot of heaven and his calculations are perfect.
I originally wanted to use heaven's punishment to force out the resentment of the saint for thousands of years, and then secretly absorb the resentment to strengthen the remaining soul, reap the benefits, and use heaven's punishment to support myself!
When Shen Qingyuan's soul is shattered and unable to resist the heavens, he can take over the Holy Maiden's holy veins, restart the perfect reincarnation, and take charge of the eternal chess game of heaven!
But he never expected that Shen Qingyuan could purify resentment and empathize with the remnant souls of thousands of years with his holy veins!
Not only was he unscathed, but with the blessing of the ten thousand-year saint, the holy power became more mellow and the soul became more stable!
If you fail to steal the chicken, you will help your opponent become stronger!
"I'm plotting against heaven, but you want to go against heaven and do good!" Remnant Soul roared sinisterly, "Then I'll see how long you can protect the eternal sorrowful soul!"
title_en: Chapter 44: The Dragon Saint resists the punishment of heaven and defies all eternity. Chapter 43: The Holy Vein spreads the heaven and earth in reverse order to seek for life.
